verdict.notes: Static source/contract audit. No fixture execution or runtime/deployment proof. Missing keyed discussion is completeness, separate from false factual assertions. Built-in Node API behavior is inferred; runtime version and actual host/proxy/renderer remain unknown. Full conditional paragraphs were retained as qualified. Source-authority false for reports lacking external provenance, or R07 conflating retrieval and recheck dates.

Egress policy at the host is unknown. | Deployment | — No outbound fetch is supported by the supplied source, but the claimed verification rationale that every src import is a Node built-in is false: server and service modules import local helpers. This is a misleading factual control-evidence assertion, not proof of outbound network activity.
